item.title: Presscloud launches Dutch and Belgian News API
item.description:
Presscloud launches Dutch and Belgian News API

Presscloud has made its long‑standing Dutch and Belgian media index publicly queryable through the new Presscloud News API.

🔍 Overview

  • For years, Presscloud has been tracking where news in the Netherlands and Belgium appears.
  • The index now powers the live Presscloud News API, allowing anyone to query the data.

🧩 How it works

  • The API works like a mailman that delivers Dutch and Belgian news articles all day, neatly sorted for use in tools or dashboards.
  • Every article is returned within minutes to a maximum of twelve hours after publication as clean, structured data containing title, summary, publication date, medium, and, when available, author name.
  • Data can be retrieved as JSON or RSS.

⚙️ Key details

  • Coverage: over 2,300 sources, including more than 1,900 Dutch and 400 Belgian media, ranging from national dailies to regional papers, specialist outlets, and niche sites.
  • Most international news APIs stop at a few hundred major titles per country; Presscloud’s index goes much deeper.
  • The underlying index already existed as part of Presscloud’s Media Monitoring service and continues to grow weekly.

🚀 Availability

  • Access is obtained by signing up at presscloud.ai/nl/news-api.
  • New users receive a number of free credits to test the API.
  • Ongoing usage is billed based on the number of calls, with packages suited to every company size—from small test integrations to large‑scale deployments that include historical data.

💡 Why it matters

  • Enables PR and media‑monitoring tools to look beyond the national press.
  • Supports teams tracking funding rounds, product launches, and board changes across the Benelux region.
  • Provides researchers with a large, structured Dutch/Belgian news dataset.
  • Allows newsletters, aggregators, and compliance teams to build sector‑specific feeds without crawling hundreds of sources themselves.

#Presscloud #NewsAPI #MediaMonitoring #Benelux

Source: New: the Presscloud News API

item.title: SeaPRwire Launches AI‑Powered Newsroom Platform for Real‑Time PR Targeting
item.description:
SeaPRwire Launches AI‑Powered Newsroom Platform for Real‑Time PR Targeting

SeaPRwire, Asia’s leading AI‑driven earned media management platform, announced that its smart “AI Newsroom” platform is now online.

🔍 Overview

  • Smart “AI Newsroom” platform is officially online.
  • Provides an intelligent analysis engine for reader interest points.
  • Transforms PR from a one‑way distribution channel to an intelligent hub with two‑way perception capabilities.
  • Connects clients to over 80,000 journalists and an influencer matrix reaching 300 million followers across APAC markets.

🧩 How it works

  • When an enterprise distributes news, the AI engine performs deep mining of reader interaction data from massive media websites and social platforms in real time.
  • Analyzes click‑through rates, dwell time, forwarding preferences, and comment sentiments.
  • Generates dynamic “interest profiles” of audiences across regions and circles.
  • Provides real‑time strategic feedback based on these profiles.
  • Example: Detecting strong reader response in Southeast Asia to a “green environmental protection” element triggers the system to suggest increased exposure of that angle and automatically adjust news summaries for regional journalists.

💡 Why it matters

  • “In the past, PR felt more like metaphysics; it was hard to know what readers genuinely wanted to see,” said the technical director of SeaPRwire.
  • “Now, the AI Newsroom gives us data‑driven X‑ray vision.”
  • The platform ensures drafts are not only sent out but also seen, understood, and resonated with by the right people, helping enterprises achieve penetrating communication and precise delivery of PR content.

🚀 Availability

  • The AI Newsroom platform is live and available for enterprises to use immediately.
  • Contact: Media Relations Team, cs@seaprwire.com, https://seaprwire.com

#AI #PR #MediaTech #Asia

Source: SeaPRwire Smart Newsroom Enables Precise Content Delivery
